---
title: "Data product execution"
format: html
execute:
  error: false
  echo: false
---

```{r}
library(lakefold)
# definitions.R defines pipeline, business_date and optional notify(event).
source("definitions.R")
lake <- dl_connect(pipeline$config)
result <- tryCatch({
  dl_run(pipeline, lake, business_date = business_date,
         notify = get0("notify", ifnotfound = NULL), stop_on_failure = FALSE)
}, finally = {
  dl_catalog_export(lake, "catalog.json")
  dl_disconnect(lake)
})
if (!result$status %in% c("published", "cached")) {
  stop("Data job failed: ", result$status, "; run: ", result$run_id)
}
print(result)
```

The persistent registry records failures even if this report does not render.
On Connect the visible HTML may still be the previous successful render.
